Neighborhood guide

The 85255 zip code defines luxury desert living. Troon features dramatic boulder-strewn terrain. DC Ranch offers master-planned elegance with mountain views and Market Street's shops and restaurants. Pinnacle Peak provides hiking and equestrian trails. Architecture embraces desert contemporary and Southwestern styles, with homes positioned to maximize views of the McDowell Mountains and city lights.

Frequently asked questions

Do you offer golf transportation in the Troon area?

Yes, we provide premium golf transportation to the championship courses across 85255. Our vehicles accommodate golf bags, and we ensure on-time arrival for your tee time.

Can you provide north Scottsdale resort transfers?

We offer VIP transfer service to the resorts in the Troon and Pinnacle Peak corridor. Our Luxury SUV (Suburban) and executive Sprinters match the standard those properties expect, with white-glove service from airport to resort.

How far is 85255 from the airports?

North Scottsdale 85255 is approximately 25 miles from Phoenix Sky Harbor and 8 miles from Scottsdale Airport. We offer airport transfers with flight monitoring. An optional greeter meets you at baggage claim with a name sign and helps with your bags for $200 flat on airport transfers, confirmed with your quote.

Do you provide hiking shuttles to Pinnacle Peak?

Yes! Pinnacle Peak is a popular hiking destination in 85255. We offer hiking shuttles that drop you at the trailhead and pick you up after your adventure. Great for visitors without rental cars.
